queries.works: SELECT count(*) FROM litkb.ws_works WHERE view_workstream_id = %(ws)s
queries.files: SELECT count(*) FROM litkb.ws_files WHERE view_workstream_id = %(ws)s
queries.file_versions: SELECT count(*) FROM litkb.file_versions WHERE workstream_id = %(ws)s
queries.blocks: SELECT count(*) FROM litkb.blocks b   JOIN litkb.ws_files f ON f.file_id = b.file_id AND f.current_run_id = b.run_id  WHERE f.view_workstream_id = %(ws)s
queries.uses: SELECT count(*) FROM litkb.use_versions WHERE workstream_id = %(ws)s
queries.hunt_requests: SELECT count(*) FROM litkb.hunt_requests WHERE workstream_id = %(ws)s
